summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 29, 2026, reporting a routine disclosure of share transactions by a managerial employee under EU Market Abuse Regulation. The filing details a sale of 526 shares by Board Member Michael Kavanagh at DKK 1,734.75 per share on NASDAQ Copenhagen. No corporate event, merger, acquisition, or strategic action is involved. The filing is a standard regulatory notification, not a special situation. It is an administrative filing with no implications for company control, capital structure, or strategic direction.
